SUN_S1E11_P01.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E11_P01.text: That is the part people usually mean by 'left.'

SUN_S1E11_P01.speaker: Renna Iles
SUN_S1E11_P01.text: No, that is the part cowards mean by it.

SUN_S1E11_P02.speaker: Renna Iles
SUN_S1E11_P02.text: You lived in that room for almost a year.

SUN_S1E11_P02.speaker: Renna Iles
SUN_S1E11_P02.text: You complained for almost a year.

SUN_S1E11_P02.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E11_P02.text: You lived somewhere for four months?

SUN_S1E11_P02.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E11_P02.text: I have survived many stationary periods.

SUN_S1E11_P02.speaker: Renna Iles
SUN_S1E11_P02.text: She cried when the cup broke.

SUN_S1E11_P02.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E11_P02.text: I swore. There may have been moisture in my eyes.

SUN_S1E11_P02.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E11_P02.text: This is the best town we've visited.

SUN_S1E11_P03.speaker: Renna Iles
SUN_S1E11_P03.text: Stay. If she hates this enough, she can leave.

SUN_S1E11_P03.speaker: Renna Iles
SUN_S1E11_P03.text: I'm not saying you betrayed me, Jess. I'm saying everything was good, and you treated that like a deadline.

SUN_S1E11_P03.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E11_P03.text: It was starting to feel decided.

SUN_S1E11_P03.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E11_P03.text: Everybody. Next season, next year, next room, next job. Like I had agreed because I hadn't objected yet.

SUN_S1E11_P03.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E11_P03.text: That was a very clear objection.

SUN_S1E11_P03.speaker: Renna Iles
SUN_S1E11_P03.text: To the rest of us it looked like an empty bed.

SUN_S1E11_P04.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E11_P04.text: If I tell you what I think, you'll start listening to Jessa for proof of it.

SUN_S1E11_P04.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E11_P04.text: Then you have an answer to that question.

SUN_S1E11_P05.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E11_P05.text: I liked it here. That's the part nobody understands.

SUN_S1E11_P05.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E11_P05.text: Why would that make you leave?

SUN_S1E11_P05.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E11_P05.text: Because everybody started talking about next year like I had already said yes to it.

SUN_S1E11_P05.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E11_P05.text: Renna thinks that's the same thing.

SUN_S1E11_P05.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E11_P05.text: Renna is allowed to be wrong about me.

SUN_S1E11_P05.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E11_P05.text: Are you going to leave us like that?

SUN_S1E11_P05.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E11_P05.text: I don't think so. That's the best answer I have.

SUN_S1E11_P05.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E11_P05.text: You said it was the answer you had.

SUN_S1E11_P06.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E11_P06.text: We can make the next stop before dark.

SUN_S1E11_P06.speaker: Renna Iles
SUN_S1E11_P06.text: You always leave when people try guilt.

SUN_S1E11_P06.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E11_P06.text: I wasn't trying to help. I asked.

SUN_S1E11_P06.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E11_P06.text: That seems to be going around.
